implementation_note.check_count_freeze: nominal rate 1/3 with n=256 variables and (dv,dc)=(2,3) gives n-k = 256 - 256/1.5 = 170.67; the natural freeze is m=170 checks ('approximately 10*(n-k)' rounded to a whole check count), which fixes k=86 information symbols and rate 86/256 = 0.3359 ~ 1/3. The total edge budget 2*n = 512 over 170 checks is 512 = 168*3 + 2*4, so exactly 168 check nodes have degree 3 and 2 have degree 4 (frozen histogram {3: 168, 4: 2}). Syndrome disclosure is exactly 10*m = 1700 bits. This note is authoritative for the freeze.
implementation_note.frozen_primary_decoder_choice: flooding FFT-QSPA is the literature-reference schedule and the primary production decoder (production_runner); layered FFT-QSPA is a frozen same-code diagnostic. Both are deterministic (workers=1), max_iter=100, damping lambda=.75 (layered only; flooding is undamped like the accepted nonbinary_qspa reference schedule), exact whole-graph syndrome check after every iteration, fail-closed on NaN/Inf/non-finite/wrong length/malformed syndrome/allocation breach, and there is no fallback between schedules. The public decoder signature (bob_symbols, syndrome, manifest, matrices, check_count, p, schedule, max_iter) contains no Alice truth.
implementation_note.message_layout: one check-to-variable float64[q] message per directed edge {(row, variable)}; exactly 512 edges for the m=170 matrix; variable-to-check extrinsics are recomputed from the prior and the stored messages (accepted v3/v5/v6 pattern) so the dense budget is bounded by the exact edge count
implementation_note.allocation_bound: declared = _declared_dense_bytes(256, 512, 1024) = (2*256 + 2*512)*1024*8 = 12582912 bytes; _MAX_DENSE_BYTES = 16 MiB; the cap is asserted before any message allocation and the declared value is reported in every result
implementation_note.canonical_codebook_bytes: b'NBLDPC7\n' magic + compact header (canonical_schema, construction_version, method, q/n/m, construction_seed, first_edge_rule, second_edge_rule, coefficient_derivation, field spec) + row-major unsigned 16-bit big-endian coefficients over the full 170 x 256 matrix; canonical_sha256/canonical_byte_length are recorded in the manifest
implementation_note.frozen_seed: 2026080400 - the first candidate found by a one-time bounded acceptance search giving full GF(1024) row rank (170) under the frozen edge rules (columns ascending, first edge min-degree + domain-separated SHA256 tiebreak, second edge BFS-PEG max local girth then min degree then the same tiebreak, parallel edges forbidden, coefficients 1 + SHA256('NBLDPC7|coef|{seed}|{row}|{col}') % 1023); never re-searched at runtime
implementation_note.reusable_apis: GF2mField/get_field_spec (nonbinary_field, public); gf_rank (nonbinary_codebook, public); qsc_symbol_priors, nonbinary_syndrome, _fwht, _normalise, _declared_dense_bytes, _result, _symbols, symbols_to_msb_bits (nonbinary_qspa, private-import pattern used by v3/v5a/v6); check_update_fft_qspa semantics identical to the accepted nonbinary_v6_long.check_update_fft_qspa / nonbinary_v3._check_update_qspa (exhaustive GF(4)/GF(8) oracle equality is asserted in T1); locked_seed_bits, materialize_seed_record, toeplitz_tag, canonical_event, transcript_summary (shared, public). No v1-v6 file was modified.
implementation_note.disclosure_accounting: syndrome exactly 10*m = 1700 bits per frame; an invoked 64-bit Toeplitz tag adds exactly 64 key-dependent bits; verification seeds are public control (seed_bit_length = n*10 + 63 = 2623, canonical packing/seed-ID rules of shared.py); unverified runs disclose no tag
implementation_note.controller: V7-01 shared ladder controller: dict-based deterministic state machine, one status per subroute (pending -> engineered -> planned -> executed -> verified -> ready | failed_canary | non_ready | blocked), advances only from a hash-bound immutable verified report (payload + recomputed SHA256 must match), no confirmation path (no confirmed status/event/transition), exactly-once execute/replay per stage enforced by the frozen transition table plus per-stage counters, no-rerun after terminal statuses. Frozen gates: canary 0/4 verified success in either stratum -> failed_canary; development ready = per-stratum >=15/16 verified success, zero forbidden failures, strict_replay_verified, disclosure <= 8.75 bits/input-symbol per stratum excluding the tag, median runtime <= 120 s/frame.
